papers.title: ConfRetro: A 3D-aware Template-free Method for Enhancing Retrosynthesis via Molecular Conformer Information
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Retrosynthesis plays a crucial role in organic synthesis and drug discovery, focusing on identifying a set of reactants capable of synthesizing a target product molecule. Although the existing approaches have shown promising results, they do not fully exploit 3D conformer information and molecular spatial structure, which can hinder stereochemically consistent and chemically plausible predictions. Results To tackle this problem, we propose ConfRetro, a Transformer-based template-free method that integrates molecular conformer information and spatial structure. We devise an Atom-align Fusion module to combine 3D positional information at model input stage, ensuring alignment between atom tokens and corresponding 3D representations. Furthermore, we design a Distance-weighted Attention mechanism to guide self-attention, constraining receptive field of model and emphasizing chemically relevant atom pairs in 3D space. Experiments conducted on the USPTO-50K and USPTO-FULL datasets demonstrate that ConfRetro significantly outperforms existing template-free approaches, achieving a new state-of-the-art performance. Case studies further highlight its capability to predict accurate and chemically plausible reactants, even for target molecules with intricate structures. Moreover, when plugged into a standard retrosynthetic search, ConfRetro recovers feasible synthetic routes for multiple representative drug molecules ( e.g. , Camptothecin). Availability and implementation The ConfRetro is available at https://github.com/Jesse-zjx/ConfRetro . Archival snapshot with https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20785018

**摘要**  
逆合成在有机合成与药物发现中发挥着至关重要的作用，其核心在于寻找能够生成目标产物的反应物组合。尽管现有方法已取得了显著进展，但它们并未充分利用分子的三维构象信息及空间结构，这限制了预测结果的立体化学一致性与合理性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了基于Transformer的无模板算法ConfRetro，该算法整合了分子构象与空间结构数据。我们在模型输入阶段设计了“原子对齐融合模块”，确保原子标记与其对应的三维结构信息保持一致；同时引入了“距离加权注意力机制”来引导模型的自注意力计算，从而优先关注三维空间中具有化学意义的原子对。在USPTO-50K及USPTO-FULL数据集上的实验结果表明，ConfRetro的性能显著优于现有无模板方法，达到了新的技术水平。案例分析进一步证明了该算法能够准确预测结构复杂的靶分子的合适反应物组合；当将其应用于标准的逆合成搜索流程时，ConfRetro还能为多种药物分子（如喜树碱）生成可行的合成路线。

**摘要**  
逆合成在有机合成与药物发现中发挥着至关重要的作用，其核心在于寻找能够生成目标产物的反应物组合。尽管现有方法已取得了显著进展，但它们并未充分利用分子的三维构象信息及空间结构，这限制了预测结果的立体化学一致性与合理性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了基于Transformer的无模板算法ConfRetro，该算法整合了分子构象与空间结构数据。我们在模型输入阶段设计了“原子对齐融合模块”，确保原子标记与其对应的三维结构信息保持一致；同时引入了“距离加权注意力机制”来引导模型的自注意力计算，从而优先关注三维空间中具有化学意义的原子对。在USPTO-50K及USPTO-FULL数据集上的实验结果表明，ConfRetro的性能显著优于现有无模板方法，达到了新的技术水平。案例分析进一步证明了该算法能够准确预测结构复杂的靶分子的合适反应物组合；当将其应用于标准的逆合成搜索流程时，ConfRetro还能为多种药物分子（如喜树碱）生成可行的合成路线。

all_papers.title: ConfRetro: A 3D-aware Template-free Method for Enhancing Retrosynthesis via Molecular Conformer Information
all_papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Retrosynthesis plays a crucial role in organic synthesis and drug discovery, focusing on identifying a set of reactants capable of synthesizing a target product molecule. Although the existing approaches have shown promising results, they do not fully exploit 3D conformer information and molecular spatial structure, which can hinder stereochemically consistent and chemically plausible predictions. Results To tackle this problem, we propose ConfRetro, a Transformer-based template-free method that integrates molecular conformer information and spatial structure. We devise an Atom-align Fusion module to combine 3D positional information at model input stage, ensuring alignment between atom tokens and corresponding 3D representations. Furthermore, we design a Distance-weighted Attention mechanism to guide self-attention, constraining receptive field of model and emphasizing chemically relevant atom pairs in 3D space. Experiments conducted on the USPTO-50K and USPTO-FULL datasets demonstrate that ConfRetro significantly outperforms existing template-free approaches, achieving a new state-of-the-art performance. Case studies further highlight its capability to predict accurate and chemically plausible reactants, even for target molecules with intricate structures. Moreover, when plugged into a standard retrosynthetic search, ConfRetro recovers feasible synthetic routes for multiple representative drug molecules ( e.g. , Camptothecin). Availability and implementation The ConfRetro is available at https://github.com/Jesse-zjx/ConfRetro . Archival snapshot with https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20785018

We devise an Atom-align Fusion module to combine 3D positional information at model input stage, ensuring alignment between atom tokens and corresponding 3D representations. Furthermore, we design a Distance-weighted Attention mechanism to guide self-attention, constraining receptive field of model and emphasizing chemically relevant atom pairs in 3D space. all_papers.llm_research_question_zh: 在伏隔核中的胆碱能中间神经元中，针对特定细胞类型实施阿片类物质的阻断作用，能够消除对吗啡的奖赏反应机制，而不会影响其镇痛效果；同时，这种阻断还能使吗啡引发的多巴胺水平升高与乙酰胆碱水平的下降相互分离。这些研究结果为采用促进胆碱能系统活性的策略来限制个体早期对阿片类物质的依赖提供了理论依据。
